items.q: What is Blu Eco Shipping & Logistics and what do you do?
items.a: Blu Eco Shipping & Logistics is a Bangladesh-based customs clearing & forwarding (C&F), freight and logistics company. We handle the documentation, duty assessment and customs formalities needed to legally import or export goods, and we move that cargo door to door through our transport partner, BdShip Trans Service.

items.q: Which ports and gateways do you operate at?
items.a: We clear and forward cargo at Chittagong Sea Port, Dhaka Airport, Benapole Land Port and ICD Komolapur, coordinated from our head office in Dhaka.

items.q: You were founded in 2026 — why should I trust you with my cargo?
items.a: Blu Eco Shipping & Logistics is a new company built on hands-on trade-logistics expertise and a commitment to transparency. You get direct access to ownership, clear costs and honest timelines, with a single point of accountability for every shipment — not a number lost in a large queue.

items.q: What makes Blu Eco Shipping & Logistics "eco"?
items.a: We plan efficient routes, match the right-sized vehicle to each load, and cut unnecessary trips and waste wherever we can. It keeps costs down for you and lightens the environmental footprint of moving your cargo.

items.q: Do you help with LC opening and duty calculation?
items.a: Yes. Our trade consultancy team advises on Letter of Credit (LC) opening and calculates the applicable tax, tariff and duties in advance, so there are no surprises at clearance.

items.q: How do I get a quote or a status update?
items.a: Send your cargo details through the quote form and we'll respond with a tailored solution, usually within one business day. For a status update, contact your Blu Eco Shipping & Logistics coordinator any time by phone or WhatsApp and we'll give you a real-time position.

customs.tagline: Authorized C&F agent operating under Bangladesh Customs regulations.
customs.long: Our team clears cargo through Chittagong Sea Port, Dhaka Airport, Benapole Land Port, ICD Komolapur and EPZ, with careful attention to accurate documentation and duty assessment. We also handle DG (dangerous goods) cargo, which needs additional paperwork and care to move safely and legally.
customs.meta: Authorized C&F agent clearing import and export cargo at Chittagong Port, Dhaka Airport, Benapole Land Port, ICD Komolapur and EPZ.

freight.tagline: Ocean, air and vessel freight, coordinated from booking to delivery.
freight.long: We arrange ocean freight (FCL and LCL), air freight and vessel/ship agency services for cargo moving in and out of Bangladesh. Our team plans oversized or complex project shipments step by step, and we handle break bulk and general cargo of every kind.
freight.meta: Ocean freight (FCL & LCL), air freight, vessel agency and project cargo, coordinated from booking to delivery in and out of Bangladesh.

specialized.tagline: Expert handling for cargo that needs extra care.
specialized.long: Some cargo needs more than standard clearance. Our team is equipped for chemical shipments, LNG/LPG equipment, DG (dangerous goods) cargo, heavy machinery such as boilers and generators, textile and RMG cargo, industrial raw materials, and branded consumer goods — each with its own handling rules and safety steps.
specialized.meta: Expert handling for chemicals, LNG/LPG equipment, dangerous goods, heavy machinery and RMG cargo, each to its own safety rules.

logistics.tagline: Complete logistics support, from the port gate to your door.
logistics.long: Once your cargo clears customs, we take it the rest of the way. Transportation runs through our BdShip Trans Service partnership, and we offer secure warehousing with inventory support, distribution and full door-to-door delivery — backed by 24/7 support, so you always know where your cargo stands.
logistics.meta: Door-to-door logistics after clearance: a partner fleet, secure warehousing, inventory management and distribution, with 24/7 support.

consultancy.tagline: LC advisory and duty & tax calculation you can plan around.
consultancy.long: Our trade consultancy team guides you through Letter of Credit (LC) opening and calculates the tax, tariff and duties that apply to your cargo — so you can plan costs accurately and avoid delays at clearance.
consultancy.meta: Letter of Credit (LC) opening advisory plus accurate duty, tax and tariff calculation, so you can plan costs and avoid clearance delays.

warehouse.tagline: Secure storage and inventory support, keeping your cargo accounted for.
warehouse.long: Our warehousing gives you a secure place to store cargo before, during and after clearance — whether you need short-term holding while paperwork is processed or long-term storage as part of your supply chain. We also manage inventory, tracking stock levels and coordinating pickup and dispatch, so the warehouse works as a real link in your logistics chain, not just a storage room.
warehouse.meta: Secure short and long-term cargo storage with inventory management, stock tracking and dispatch coordination for your supply chain.

about.title: A new generation of trade logistics in Bangladesh
about.subtitle: A customs clearing, forwarding and logistics company built on efficiency, transparency and environmental responsibility.
story: Blu Eco Shipping & Logistics was founded in 2026 by Engr. Mushfiq-Uz-Zaman Chowdhury with a clear conviction: that customs clearing and logistics in Bangladesh can be faster, more transparent and more environmentally responsible than the industry norm.

From our head office in Dhaka, we clear and forward cargo across Chittagong Sea Port, Dhaka Airport, Benapole Land Port and ICD Komolapur — and move it door to door through our transport partner, BdShip Trans Service. We pair hands-on trade expertise with modern systems and a lighter environmental footprint.
about.vision: To become Bangladesh's most trusted name in sustainable trade logistics — where efficiency, transparency and environmental responsibility move together.
mission: Deliver end-to-end clearing and forwarding with accuracy and speed.
Make import and export straightforward through expert LC advisory and duty/tax consultation.
Provide safe, reliable transportation and warehousing tailored to each client.
Reduce the environmental footprint of every shipment we handle.
about.philosophy: We become your business partner — understanding your product and your goals, then offering clear advice and practical solutions for your import and export cargo, backed by a hands-on team available 24/7.
about.wing: Through our MOU with BdShip Trans Service, we access a dedicated fleet of cover vans, mini cover vans, multi-purpose trucks and trailers — operated by skilled, careful drivers for safe delivery nationwide, with the right-sized vehicle assigned to every load.
about.leadershipSubtitle: The person accountable for your cargo.

leader.name: Engr. Mushfiq-Uz-Zaman Chowdhury
credentials: B.Sc. in Electrical & Electronic Engineering (EEE), Independent University, Bangladesh (IUB)
Master in Port & Shipping Management (MPSM), Bangladesh Maritime University
leader.bio: Blu Eco Shipping & Logistics is led by its founder, who pairs an engineering background with formal training in port and shipping management. He oversees operations personally — keeping the company responsive, accountable and focused on doing clearing and forwarding the right way.
leader.message: Financial and economic development form the backbone of Bangladesh's growth, and both depend heavily on trade. Recognizing this, I founded Blu Eco Shipping & Logistics to strengthen the industrial sector through backward linkage support across international trade, import and export, and logistics services. Bangladesh's industries face a persistent challenge: fragmented, unreliable logistics that slow down production and raise costs. Raw materials arrive late, finished goods miss export windows, heavy equipment sits idle in transit, and inadequate warehousing disrupts supply chains. These inefficiencies weaken the competitiveness of our exporters on the global stage.

about.structure: A single accountable head office in Dhaka coordinates clearance across Chittagong Sea Port, Dhaka Air Freight, Benapole Land Port and ICD Komolapur, supported by customs and jetty sarkers, documentation staff and skilled transport crews.

roadTransportPage.title: Right-sized transport for every load.
roadTransportPage.subtitle: From small parcels to 40-ton industrial loads — moved through our BdShip Trans Service partnership, with full control from pickup to delivery.
intro: Blu Eco Shipping & Logistics moves cargo of every size across Bangladesh through our MOU with BdShip Trans Service, giving us direct access to a dedicated fleet built for exactly this kind of work. From small parcels to 40-ton industrial loads, this partnership lets us manage transport in-house rather than relying on scattered third-party carriers, which means fewer delays, better tracking, and full control over your cargo from pickup to delivery.

We match the right vehicle to the size of your consignment. A small order does not need a container truck, and a factory-scale shipment cannot move on a pickup van. Through our BdShip partnership, we assess your cargo volume and assign the right truck for the job, so you never pay for more capacity than you need, and your goods never travel in a vehicle too small to carry them safely. Right-sizing every trip also keeps fuel use and emissions down.

We deliver from any port in Bangladesh, Chittagong Sea Port, Dhaka Airport, Benapole Land Port, or ICD Komolapur, to anywhere in the country. Every delivery is handled by trained, careful drivers who understand the value and urgency of the cargo they carry. Backed by our MOU with BdShip, once we commit to a delivery timeline, we hold to it.
roadTransportPage.fleetSubtitle: By vehicle type — we assign the right one to your consignment.

pickup.name: Small Pickup
pickup.desc: Our small pickups are built for light, fast deliveries — the right choice for sample shipments, small cartons, retail stock and urgent city deliveries where speed matters more than volume. They let us dispatch quickly without tying up a larger vehicle.

truck.name: Truck
truck.desc: Our mid-size trucks carry medium-volume consignments such as palletised goods, packaged retail products and general cargo that outgrows a pickup but does not need a full container truck. This size covers most day-to-day distribution across the country.

containerTruck.name: Container Truck
containerTruck.desc: These trucks move full container loads directly from port to factory or warehouse. Built for standard shipping containers, they are the backbone of our port-to-door container transport, keeping your goods sealed and secure from the moment they leave the port.

trailer.name: Trailer
trailer.desc: Our trailers handle the heaviest cargo we move — industrial machinery, boilers, steel plates and other oversized equipment. This is our largest-capacity group, built specifically for heavy-lift work.

lngTanker.name: LNG Tanker Truck
lngTanker.desc: Our specialized LNG tanker trucks transport liquid gas cargo safely and in compliance with strict handling regulations. They are reserved for LNG and LPG shipments that require this specific equipment and trained handling procedures.
